name: Bank Soal PDF & Sistem Kunci Jawaban LJK
description: Sistem manajemen Bank Soal PDF institusional dengan pratinjau split file, editor kunci jawaban interaktif LJK (PG, PGK, T/F, Essay), ekspor format LJK Excel otomatis, integrasi Neon PostgreSQL & Google Drive, serta kontrol akses berbasis peran (RBAC).
